tool_input_args.value:
python3 << 'EOF'
import openpyxl
from openpyxl.styles import Font, Alignment

wb = openpyxl.Workbook()
ws = wb.active
ws.title = "Extracted Text"

# Set column width
ws.column_dimensions['A'].width = 15
ws.column_dimensions['B'].width = 60

# Header row
ws['A1'] = 'Source'
ws['B1'] = 'Extracted Text'
for cell in [ws['A1'], ws['B1']]:
    cell.font = Font(bold=True, size=12)
    cell.alignment = Alignment(horizontal='center')

# Read the extracted text
with open('/workspace/testbed/docs/handbook.txt', 'r') as f:
    lines = [line for line in f.read().strip().splitlines() if line.strip()]

# Write each line into a row
for i, line in enumerate(lines, start=2):
    ws.cell(row=i, column=1, value=f'Page 1, Line {i-1}')
    ws.cell(row=i, column=2, value=line)

output_path = '/workspace/testbed/docs/handbook_extracted.xlsx'
wb.save(output_path)
print(f"Excel file saved to: {output_path}")
print(f"Rows written: {len(lines)}")
EOF
